who_iuis_allergen_nomenclature.terms_observed: The official download page says the database is free to download and requests citation of the database URL and a recent official WHO/IUIS publication. No blanket redistribution license was established from the inspected page.
who_iuis_allergen_nomenclature.access_note: The official HTML table was inspected through the web research connector. Direct HTTP requests to the CSV/HTML download endpoints from the local execution environment returned 403; no source file was downloaded or bypassed.

fda_major_food_allergen_categories.scope: US major-allergen labeling categories only; not a complete ingredient-to-allergen database or a clinical safety rule.

interpretation.row_meaning: One WHO/IUIS-named allergen protein and its recorded source taxon, with route recorded as Food. This is positive source/protein evidence for the named record only.
not_established: that every ingredient, cultivar, plant part, derivative, oil, extract, or processed form from that taxon contains the protein
absence of an allergen in an ingredient or finished recipe
cross-contact status, dose, individual clinical significance, or safety for any person
coverage of every species within a broad FDA category (for example, fish or tree nuts)
a validated synonym or recipe-ingredient identity join
interpretation.safe_negative_policy: No row, missing record, or missing relationship must never be interpreted as allergen-free or safe.
interpretation.clinical_significance_policy: WHO/IUIS says its nomenclature committee requires minimum evidence of IgE binding to the proposed allergen using sera from people allergic to the source, but inclusion is not a judgement of clinical significance.

records.record_evidence_summary: The page reports IgE binding to Ara h 2 among tested peanut-allergic patients (34/40 by immunoblot; 6/6 in an ELISA statement). These are the cited study samples, not prevalence estimates.
The page reports IgE binding to Bos d 8 in 58/92 milk-allergic children in an enzyme immunoassay. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.
The page reports IgE binding to purified ovomucoid in 32/33 patients allergic to egg white by RAST. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.
The page reports IgE binding to Gad m 1 for sera from 12/12 tested cod-allergic patients in ELISA and 5/5 in immunoblot. These are cited study samples, not prevalence estimates.
The page reports IgE reaction to natural Pen m 1 in 11/16 shrimp-allergic patients by immunoblot. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.
The page reports IgE binding to recombinant Jug r 1 in 12/16 patients with systemic walnut-allergic reactions. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.
The page reports IgE antibodies to purified Tri a 19 in 27/27 patients with wheat-dependent exercise-induced anaphylaxis. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.

records.evidence_note: No allergenicity summary was displayed on the inspected individual record page; do not infer a study result from this null field.

records.record_evidence_summary: The page reports IgE binding to sesame antigens in all 10 tested sesame-allergic patients and identifies Ses i 1 as the major 9 kDa protein. This is the cited study sample, not a population estimate.
